## Basic Information
- Serbian crime drama series
- Original Serbian title: "Čistači"
- Premiered in 2022
- Produced for Serbian television

## Plot
The series follows a specialized team that "cleans up" crime scenes and handles sensitive situations, operating in a gray area between law enforcement and criminal activities. The show explores themes of moral ambiguity, loyalty, and survival in the criminal underworld.

## Production
- Created as part of the growing Serbian television drama industry
- Features high production values typical of modern Serbian crime dramas
- Part of a wave of successful Serbian TV shows gaining regional attention

- Gained popularity in Serbia and the broader Balkan region
- Contributed to the reputation of Serbian television for producing quality crime dramas

Serbian television has gained recognition in recent years for producing compelling crime series that often get distributed throughout the former Yugoslav region and sometimes internationally through streaming platforms.
